COVERED_ADDRESS.TITLE: Covered Addresses
COVERED_ADDRESS.SUBTITLE: Configure where you deliver, with per-area branch, delivery charge, minimum order, and free-delivery threshold.
COVERED_ADDRESS.TYPE_HINT: Pick how addresses are organized. Built-in types auto-generate rows from the country list; type your own to free-form.
COVERED_ADDRESS.TYPE_CONFIRM: Switching the type will reset the addresses to defaults for the new type. Continue?
COVERED_ADDRESS.CONFIRM_DELETE_SELECTED: Delete {{count}} selected address(es)? This can't be undone.
COVERED_ADDRESS.EMPTY: Pick an address type above to populate the table — or click Add address to type one yourself.

BULK.PANEL_HINT: Apply values to every selected row, or push to all rows at once.
BULK.NO_FIELDS: Fill at least one field to apply.
BULK.NO_SELECTION: Select at least one address row first.
BULK.CONFIRM_BODY_SEL: Apply the filled fields to {{count}} selected address(es)?
BULK.CONFIRM_BODY_ALL: Apply the filled fields to ALL {{count}} address(es)? This overwrites existing values.

COVERED_ADDRESS.ERR_DUPLICATE_NAMES: Two addresses share the same name. Make them unique before saving.
COVERED_ADDRESS.ERR_MISSING_NAME_OR_BRANCH: Every address needs a name and a branch (Governorate type doesn't require a branch).
COVERED_ADDRESS.ERR_NO_ROWS: Add at least one address before saving.

IMPORT.TITLE: Import covered addresses
IMPORT.HINT: Paste rows or pick a CSV/XLSX file. The first row may be a header (auto-detected). Imported rows replace the table — click Save afterwards to persist.
IMPORT.ERR_UNKNOWN_BRANCH: Branch "{{branch}}" doesn't match any of your branches
IMPORT.REQ_FIELD_BRANCH: Branch (must match an existing branch name exactly)
IMPORT.REQ_FIELD_NUMBERS: Delivery charge / min. order / free delivery over (numeric, leave free-delivery blank for none)
IMPORT.MODE_ADD_UPDATE_DESC: Merge by address. Existing addresses get their values overwritten with the imported values; addresses not in the file are kept as-is.
IMPORT.MODE_OVERRIDE_DESC: Discard the entire current list and keep only what was imported.
IMPORT.MODE_ADD_ONLY_DESC: Keep existing addresses untouched. Only append rows whose address isn't already covered.
IMPORT.MODE_HINT_ADD_UPDATE: Add/Update: merge by address, incoming wins
IMPORT.MODE_HINT_OVERRIDE: Override: replace the entire current list
IMPORT.MODE_HINT_ADD_ONLY: Add Only: skip addresses that already exist
IMPORT.TIP: Use Add or Update for most imports — it merges your file with the existing table without losing anything else. Remember to click Save when you're done; the import only stages changes.
